messages:
Aisha: FYI reconciling April sandbox GPU spend and found a ~$5.6k block charged to project 'playground-eu' but labels are messy. sample rows from the BQ export: project=playground-eu | sku=NVIDIA_T4 | cost=612.34 | labels.owner=eng-experiments
Ben: which export/dataset? we allocate by labels.team. owner alone means it falls to central sandbox pool. can you paste raw rows? :eyes:
Aisha: pasted a few more rows below. noticed owner vs team mismatch and some rows missing both labels:
`project: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_T4 | cost: 1024.12 | labels.owner: eng-carlos`
`project: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_A100 | cost: 3487.26 | labels.team: research`
`project: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_T4 | cost: 612.34 | labels.owner: eng-experiments`
billing-bot: ALERT: sandbox-eu daily threshold exceeded (1,000 USD). Ticket BILL-1123 created.
Carlos: that 1k was my Friday stress test. I used owner=eng-carlos instead of team=eng-experiments. my bad. can we backfill so finance attributes correctly? :wave:
Dana: short-term: run tag-based backfill against the BQ export then re-run allocation. commands we use locally:
`./tools/chargeback/backfill --from-bq projects/redwood-billing/datasets/gcp_billing_export_v1 --project playground-eu --label owner --map owner_to_team.json`
`python scripts/allocate_charges.py --project playground-eu --start 2026-03-01`
Ben: i'll kick off the backfill + re-run allocate_charges. also deploying a nightly converter to copy owner->team when team missing to avoid drift. ETA ~12:15 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aisha: finance: after the run should we invoice eng-experiments or keep it on central sandbox? we have reserved research credits but prefer sign-off on cross-charges.
Marta: finance ack. ping me with the post-run allocation CSV. if it maps to eng-experiments we'll approve a cross-charge; otherwise it stays on central sandbox and we'll follow up.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-1123 updated: backfill scheduled by Ben (ETA 12:15 UTC).
Dana: i'll add a tiny infra hook to fail GPU provisioning if labels.team missing + a playbook note. small PR incoming.
Carlos: updating my test scripts to set labels.team. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Aisha: tagging @Marta for final sign-off after allocation run. once Marta confirms i'll close the ticket. :white_check_mark:
